notes.title: Patch Release Notice Ver. 1.03
notes.content:
[h3]・Fixed “Import” Display Issue on Title Screen[/h3][p]Resolved an issue where the “Import” option was displayed even without YsX clear data.[/p][p]*Note: On Steam Deck, each game creates a virtual Windows C: drive, preventing access to save data folders from other applications. [/p][p][/p][h3]・Adjusted Target Lock Behavior[/h3][p]Fixed a problem where moving the mouse while a target was locked could unintentionally switch the lock to a different target. [/p][p][/p][h3]・Fixed Screen Distortion During Events[/h3][p]Addressed an issue that could cause visual distortion during certain in-game events.[/p][p][/p][h3]・Additional Minor Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][p]We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.
Thank you for your continued support. 
We’ll keep listening to your feedback and working hard to deliver the best possible gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Release Notice Ver. 1.01
notes.content: [h3]Fixed an issue where the game could crash when using certain GPUs, including AMD Radeon XT models.[/h3][p]We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. We’ll keep listening to your feedback and working hard to deliver the best possible gaming experience.[/p]
